content: For individuals who successfully achieve weight loss, it is crucial to provide long-term support to sustain their progress. Regular follow-up appointments and continuous monitoring of body weight are highly recommended. Encouraging self-monitoring strategies, such as periodic weigh-ins and tracking physical activity, is also essential. These measures can help prevent weight regain and ensure the maintenance of the positive outcomes achieved during the initial weight loss phase. Additionally, maintaining a consistent level of physical activity is advised, with a target of approximately 200 to 300 minutes per week. This level of activity plays a significant role in supporting long-term weight stability.
